parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of a bucket, typically made of durable plastic. It is a curved component attached to the upper sides of the bucket.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, providing leverage and comfort during transport.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can rotate or pivot around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing it to move up and down for carrying or resting.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the bucket, made of molded plastic with a cylindrical or conical shape.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds liquids or solids, serving as the primary container for the bucket’s intended use.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a fixed, rigid structure that does not move independently; it supports the handle and contains the contents.
